findings.evidence: WP-SCP-022 §4.5 requires fix-round-N/ to contain: dispatch-package.json, codex-stdout.txt (Codex full transcript, 5 MB cap), review-*.json, and consolidation.md (orchestrator verdict consolidation for the round). Glob of fix-round-1/ after 90c4890: dispatch-package.json ✓, dispatcher-result.json (structured Codex output, not a transcript), dispatcher-stderr.txt, fixpoint.md (misplaced notes — see CG-R3-CF-001), review-*-package.json ✓, review-*.json ✓. No codex-stdout.txt. No consolidation.md. Commit 90c4890 added consolidation-r1.json at the flat dispatches/021b/ level — a new positive artifact containing the full R1 multi-lens findings. However: it is at the wrong level (flat 021b/ not inside fix-round-1/), uses JSON not markdown format, and is not named consolidation.md. Neither absence was addressed by fix-round-2 scope.
findings.impact: Audit trail gap for fix-round-1 persists: no Codex execution transcript or synthetic substitute exists inside the round directory, so inspectors cannot determine from fix-round-1/ alone whether the round was Codex-executed or Opus-orchestrator-executed. Without fix-round-1/consolidation.md, the orchestrator's R2 verdict reasoning is unrecorded in the canonical schema location. The flat-level consolidation-r1.json is a compensating improvement but does not close the §4.5 gap.
findings.mitigation: Add fix-round-1/codex-stdout.txt (synthetic: 'Fix-round-1 executed by Opus orchestrator directly; no separate Codex dispatch session. See dispatcher-result.json for structured result.') and fix-round-1/consolidation.md (recording that R2 reviews returned: all lenses APPROVED_WITH_FINDINGS; safety MAJ R2-S-01 remained open; §4.3 fixpoint not met; fix-round-2 dispatched to close R2-S-01). Retain the flat-level consolidation-r1.json as an additional cross-lens reference.

findings.claim: All three slice implementation commits lack the WP-SCP-021 §4 parent-plan citation required by WP-SCP-022 §4.1; fix-round-2 added a third violation without resolving the first two
findings.evidence: WP-SCP-022 §4.1: commits must cite the parent slice text by file path + section. Commit 2e73b13: 'WP-SCP-022 slice 021B: MCP server scaffold + Ed25519 keygen + PyPI extras' — no citation (flagged R1 CG-MIN-003, unresolved). Commit b6f1774: 'Slice 021B fix-round R1: close 8 MAJ from R1 review' — no citation (flagged R2 CG-R2-MIN-005, unresolved). Commit 90c4890: 'Slice 021B fix-round R2 + R2 review evidence' — no citation. Three successive fix rounds each introduced a new violation. None of the prior citations appear in any commit message on the branch.
findings.impact: Automated queries ('which commits implement WP-SCP-021 §4 deliverables?') cannot locate any of the three commits without traversing the evidence directory. Future agents recovering from git log cannot find the parent-plan link. The §4.7 gate helper convention check cannot be enforced retroactively after merge.
findings.mitigation: Before the PR opens, amend all three commits to append 'Implements WP-SCP-021 §4 row 021B (docs/plans/WP-SCP-021-scp-as-mcp-server.md)'. If amendment is blocked by branch protection, record the canonical citation as a compensating control in dispatches/021b/fixpoint.md and add the citation-format check to the §4.7 gate helper as a hard gate for future slices.

findings.claim: mcp SDK is still pinned via a direct files.pythonhosted.org URL rather than a PEP 440 version specifier with hash-checking mode, persisting across R1, R2, and R3 without remediation
findings.evidence: pyproject.toml line 34: 'mcp @ https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/m/mcp/mcp-1.27.0.tar.gz#sha256=d3dc35a7eec0d458c1da4976a48f982097ddaab87e278c5511d5a4a56e852b83'. Unaddressed in fix-round-1 or fix-round-2. fix-round-2 did not modify the mcp dependency line.
findings.impact: Pip cannot express a version-range constraint relative to packages declaring mcp>=X.Y. Renovate cannot infer minimum upgrade bound from the URL. CDN path stability is residual risk. Not a merge blocker; PyPI guarantees sdist stability.
findings.mitigation: Consider migrating to 'mcp==1.27.0' with a companion constraints file using --hash=sha256:d3dc35a7... per WP-SCP-020 §4 020F Renovate-pin guidance. Suitable as 021C pre-condition. Not a blocker.

findings.claim: test_cli_help.py line 17 retains a vacuously-true assertion: assert resolve_scp_mcp_server() always evaluates to True because the fallback returns a non-empty list
findings.evidence: test_cli_help.py:17 — 'assert resolve_scp_mcp_server()'. conftest.py resolve_scp_mcp_server() returns [sys.executable, '-m', 'standards_control_plane.mcp_server.cli'] as fallback when the binary is absent; a non-empty list is always truthy in Python. The assertion cannot fail under any code path. Unaddressed across R2 (CG-R2-nit-003) and R3.
findings.impact: Minor misleading assertion — a reader expects it to guard against a missing install. No test-correctness impact; the underlying run_scp_mcp_server call still exercises the correct binary or module path.
findings.mitigation: Remove line 17, or replace with an explicit install-state check that calls pytest.skip('scp-mcp-server binary not on PATH; install via pip install -e .[dev,mcp]') when the binary is absent from PATH.
